title: TOR: CMG Capacity Building and BDS Support Program (PAMOJA Project)
description: PMO-RALG invites qualified firms to provide Business Development Services (BDS) for training, capacity building and mentoring of Community Microfinance Groups (CMGs) under the World Bank-financed PAMOJA Project. Biharamulo District Council is among the targeted implementation areas in Kagera Region.

contact.name: PMO-RALG / Biharamulo District Council
contact.address: Prime Minister's Office – Regional Administration and Local Government, Tanzania

eligibility: Qualified firms with minimum 10 years experience in CMG/VSLA, financial inclusion, or livelihoods programs; demonstrated experience in Tanzania preferred.
